doc:
Social Proof of Truth (SPoT)
 Prediction market for post truthfulness. Users bet on custom options (2-10 options per record).
 All bets go directly to escrow. Oracle/DAO resolves the outcome, and winners receive
 pro-rata payouts from the total escrow pool. Users can withdraw bets before resolution
 with the same fee structure as payouts. Time-based resolution windows are optional per record.

total_option_escrow.doc: Sum of per-option escrow (same aggregation as resolve).

create_spot_admin_cap.doc: Create a SpotAdminCap for bootstrap (package visibility only)

create_spot_oracle_admin_cap.doc: Create a SpotOracleAdminCap for bootstrap (package visibility only)

update_spot_config.doc:
Update SPoT configuration (admin only).
 `max_single_bet` and `max_bets_per_record` use `0` for no limit; positive values enforce caps.

rescale_spot_config_windows_from_epoch_c.doc: After upgrading from epoch-count semantics, multiply stored window fields by `epoch_duration_ms` so they become wall-clock durations.

patch_spot_record_times_for_migration.doc: Oracle-only: fix record timestamps/window fields after upgrade (off-chain supplies correct `created_at_ms` and optional windows in ms).

withdraw_spot_bet.doc:
Withdraw a bet before resolution
 Applies same fee structure as payouts
 Only allowed when status is OPEN (not DAO_REQUIRED, not RESOLVED, not REFUNDABLE)

place_spot_bet.doc: Place bet - all funds go to escrow

oracle_resolve.doc:
Oracle resolution (option_id, or too close → DAO_REQUIRED)
 Requires reasoning and at least one evidence URL for transparency and accountability

submit_spot_resolution_proposal_to_gover.doc: Submit a governance proposal to ratify one outcome for a contested SPoT market.

implement_spot_resolution_from_governanc.doc: After community voting approves a linked proposal, resolve the market and pay winners.

clear_spot_proposal_link_on_reject.doc: Clear the active proposal link after a rejected or quorum-failed governance outcome.

finalize_spot_governance_proposal.doc: Finalize linked SPoT governance voting; clears the record link when the proposal is rejected.

finalize_via_dao.doc: Deprecated direct DAO finalization — requires an approved linked governance proposal.

refund_unresolved.doc:
Refund all escrow if unresolved beyond max window
 Requires SpotOracleAdminCap authorization
 If max_resolution_window_ms is None, this function cannot be called (must be explicitly set)

claim_payout.doc:
Claim payout after delay period has passed
 Users can claim their winnings after payout_delay_ms has elapsed since resolution

SpotAdminCap.doc: Admin capability for SPoT (controls SpotConfig updates)

SpotOracleAdminCap.doc: Oracle admin capability for SPoT (controls oracle decisions: record creation and resolution)

timestamp_ms.doc: Wall-clock ms from `Clock` when the bet was placed.
